title: AIPC: Evidence-Guided Agent Workflows for PyTorch Project Deployment
abstract: arXiv:2610.34890v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deploying and optimizing a PyTorch inference project on a dedicated accelerator, especially an on-device NPU, requires more than using a framework device API as with CUDA. The project must be converted into hardware-runtime artifacts and adapted to the target toolchain and application interface. Differences in model formats, quantization flows, operator support, and toolchain interfaces create cross-layer problems spanning PyTorch/ONNX models, toolchains, runtimes, and device execution. LLM Agents can invoke tools to address such problems, but may drift because of insufficient domain knowledge, large configuration and repair spaces, or poor path selection.   We propose AIPC (AI Porting & Conversion), an Agent method for deploying PyTorch inference projects. AIPC combines structured Skills with toolchain, runtime, and profiling evidence to drive cross-layer diagnosis and repair, organizing model adaptation, artifact building, on-target

translated_title: AIPC：面向PyTorch项目部署的证据引导式智能体工作流
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.34890v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：在专用加速器上部署和优化PyTorch推理项目，尤其是端侧NPU，并非仅使用类似CUDA的框架设备API就能完成。项目必须被转换为硬件运行时工件，并适配目标工具链和应用程序接口。模型格式、量化流程、算子支持和工具链接口方面的差异会产生跨越PyTorch/ONNX模型、工具链、运行时和设备执行的跨层问题。LLM智能体可以调用工具来解决此类问题，但由于领域知识不足、配置和修复空间庞大或路径选择不佳，可能会出现偏差。我们提出AIPC（AI Porting & Conversion），一种用于部署PyTorch推理项目的智能体方法。AIPC将结构化技能与工具链、运行时和性能分析证据相结合，以驱动跨层诊断和修复，组织模型适配、工件构建、端上部署等环节。
tldr: 提出AIPC方法，通过将结构化技能与工具链、运行时和性能分析证据相结合，引导智能体进行跨层诊断与修复，实现PyTorch推理项目在专用加速器（尤其是端侧NPU）上的自动化部署与移植。
en_tdlr: AIPC is an agent method that combines structured Skills with toolchain, runtime, and profiling evidence to guide cross-layer diagnosis and repair, enabling automated deployment and porting of PyTorch inference projects on dedicated accelerators such as on-device NPUs.
